mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM member WHERE email = #{email} AND is_active = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO member (email, password, name, phone, profile_img, provider, provider_id, email_verified, role, zip_code, address, address_detail) VALUES (#{email}, #{password}, #{name}, #{phone}, #{profileImg}, #{provider}, #{providerId}, #{emailVerified}, #{role}, #{zipCode}, #{address}, #{addressDetail})
mapper.update: UPDATE member SET name = #{name}, phone = #{phone}, profile_img = #{profileImg}, zip_code = #{zipCode}, address = #{address}, address_detail = #{addressDetail}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE member_id = #{memberId}
UPDATE member SET email_verified = 'Y', updated_at = NOW() WHERE member_id = #{memberId}
